notes.title: Patch 1.9.6b - Bivouac on DLC Maps & Time Attack QOL

notes.title: Peaks of Yore - Art Contest
notes.content:
Greetings, peak baggers!

[i]The Official Ascension Society is looking for an artist![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661083/2e2d966715d3efcc356aa0a71711d011cbda432e.png[/img]

We're hosting an [b]Art Contest[/b] on the [b]Peaks of Yore Discord Community[/b] server, where you have a chance to [b]get your art displayed in-game[/b]! 🎨
[list]
[*] https://discord.gg/FkkCBgm2
[/list]

[list]
[*] You have to create a Peaks of Yore landscape representation of your choice. (A peak or a scenery for example)
[*] It must be a drawing, a painting or a digital art.
[*] It must be an original creation (no screenshots, or image directly taken from the game).
[*] AI generations will [u]NOT[/u] be accepted.
[*] The art must be posted in ⁠⁠fan-art-contest-1 (the channel will become visible at the start of the event). Your art needs a title and you can also post a sentence describing your art if you want. However, no discussion will be allowed in this channel.
[*]Only 2 submissions maximum per participant.

[list]
[*] The contest will last 3 weeks total.
[*] Submissions are accepted from [b]3rd February 2025 12pm CET[/b] to [b]17th February 2025 12:00pm CET[/b].
[*] Voting starts from [b]17th February 2025 12pm CET[/b] to [b]24th February 2025 12pm CET[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Submission Requirements 🗒️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Art resolution must be [b]1920 x 1080[/b].
[*] File type should be either [b]PNG[/b] or [b]JPG[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Voting ⭐[/h3]
[list]
[*] Once voting begins, you can vote for your favourite art by clicking the ⭐ reaction emoji under the art posted.
[*] The winner will be the person whose art will have received the most reactions.
[*] Any attempt to vote more than once with multiple accounts will not be allowed.
[/list]

[h2]Rewards 🏆[/h2]

[h3]Winner 🥇[/h3]
[list]

[*]The winner's art will be [b]displayed in-game[/b] until the next Art contest! 
The art will be displayed in a picture frame inside The Great Gales Cabin. Additionally, they will receive the OAS Artist role.
[/list]
[h3]Honorable Mentions 🎖️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Admins and Moderators will select an honorable mention and their art will become the new discord banner for 2 months.
[/list]
If you're artistically inclined, we'd love to see you participate! The official post with rules can be found in announcements.

We hope a lot of you will be participating so we can make this a returning event, ideally every 2-3 months. Good luck!

notes.title: Patch 1.9.3f - Climbing Stats and Time Attack Trophies
notes.content:
[h2]Stats[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now view your lifetime climbing stats from the Main Menu under "[b]Stats[/b]".
[*] Stats shown are total summits, holds used, crampon jumps used, coffee drinks, [u]and much more.[/u]
[*] You can also track total regular summits, free solo summits, night summits, and cruel summits on each individual peak under [b]Stats > All Peaks[/b].
[*] Stats will only show for categories that have been unlocked at least once. 
Time attack related stats will also only show up if you have acquired the Pocket Watch at least once.
[*] Stats won't be saved if you quit by using Alt-F4 or closing the game using the task manager. Stats are saved when you stamp a peak, set a time attack score, or quit.
[/list]
[h2]All Peaks - Individual Peak Stats[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now see [b]Summits[/b], [b]FreeSolo Summits[/b] ([i]including free solos on regular peaks[/i]), [b]Night Summits[/b], and [b]Cruel Summits[/b] on each individual peak in both The Great Gales and The Great Alps.
[*] You can also see a total from each of these types of summits.
[/list]
[h2]Time Attack - Overall Score Trophies[/h2]
[list]
[*] Under stats, you can now see your [b]Overall Time Attack Scores[/b]. These track your [i]time[/i], [i]holds[/i], and [i]rope[/i] usages scores across all maps. 
[*] These scores are [b]added together from each peak to display the overall score of each individual type[/b]. The Great Gales and The Great Alps are tracked separately.
[*] There are a total of 4 regular time attack medal tiers to obtain, including 2 secret ones. 
[b]Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum[/b]. Gold, Platinum, and above can only be obtained after completing Great Bulwark and Solemn Tempest in any normal save file. If these two are not completed, the highest you'll receive is Silver. For the DLC, Gold, and Platinum can be obtained after completing the Eldris Wall.
[*] The different requirements for reaching any of these tiers can be seen under [b]Stats > Score Tiers[/b].
[*] 2 secret trophies can be unlocked for the extremely fast players. More on these in the section below.
[*] The Overall Time Attack Scores are only tracked from the first Normal Playthrough slot file (Slot 1).
[*] If you have completed the game, you'll automatically have at least one of each summit completed. For obvious reasons, it's impossible to backwards track things like total ice axe holds or chalk uses from before this patch, so some estimates have been done based on game progress.
[*] [b]Note[/b]: For those that have played the game without ropes and would like to keep the total rope stat at zero, the initial load of the Stats screen will only collect "total ropes used" if you have used any when setting time attack scores on peaks. Please keep this in mind before opening the Stats screen.
[*] It might take a few seconds when loading stats for the very first time, as the game will try to gather your previous stat scores. 
[*] You can find a list of the different Time Attack Score Tier requirements in Stats > Score Tiers. 
[/list]
[h2]Speed-climbing Trophies[/h2]
[list]
[*] On top of the regular new time attack achievements, there are 2 additional secret speed-climbing trophies that can be achieved for the Time scores. These are for the truly fast speed-climbers. 
[*] The time requirements for them can be seen once Platinum is achieved.
[*] Achieving any of these will automatically grant the same reward to holds and ropes. 
[*] [b]GOOD LUCK LOL[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a tooltip for Wally Mode so that it's more clear that you need to start a fresh save file in order to progress.
[*] The Northern Range and Solemn Tempest are now visible from Giant's Shelf, Aldr Grotto, and Old Skerry.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where deleting a save file with Wally mode completed would prevent access to Avian Chaos. Both of these modes should now unlock permanently once initially unlocked.
[*] Fixed a bug with slopers while paused.
[*] Fixed a hole on Eldris Wall.
[*] Fixed a bug with the description on bird seeds.
[*] Fixed a bug with drinking coffee while setting a time attack score.
[*] Fixed a bug with reset colliders.
[*] Fixed a bug with arms while drinking coffee.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Patch 1.9.3a (Hotfix)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Time Attack Score Tiers have been updated to be more balanced.
[*] You can now select which modes and slots to display for Overall Time Attack. This will only load time scores in the selected files from the dropdowns, and will not change the Total values displayed on the left.
[*] Overall Time Attack achievements are now saved depending on which mode you play in. So you can achieve time attack achievements for both Normal, You Fall You Die, and Free Solo. 
[*] Fixed a bug where reaching Platinum didn't show new tiers.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Alps entrance from the Northern Outpost Cabin.
[*] Fixed a bug with some secret time attack trophies.
[*] Fixed a bug with holds being recorded if the score was already 0 in the Expert Category.
[/list]
[h2]Patch 1.9.3b[/h2]

[h3]Stats[/h3]
[list]
[*] Selecting Free Solo will no longer show rope scores since they aren't available.
[*] Removed the late game summit requirements to reach Gold.
[*] Increased the minimum time required to achieve gold in the Great Alps. Removal of late gate summit requirements from this achievement in both regions should make them a bit easier to reach overall. Platinum remains the same.
[*] Increased the time needed to achieve Silver in The Great Gales. From 2 hours to 2 hours and 30 mins.
[*] The initial Score fetching will now search through all slots in all modes. Previously, first-time setup of the stats would only fetch data from the first slot Normal Playthrough file.
[*] If you want to try fetching previous scores from all your slot files, you'll have to delete the file called "[b]global_stats.es3[/b]" found in the location [u]%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\TraipseWare\Peaks of Yore[/u]
[*] This paste the above line into the address bar of a folder or in windows search to open the location.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with Porter's Boulder and Wuthering Crest not storing stats correctly.
[*] Fixed some issues related to not storing summits correctly on initial load.
[/list]
[h2]Patch 1.9.3c[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would reset stats when entering and exiting the cabin in the Great Gales. If you experienced this bug, you can delete the "[b]global_stats.es3[/b]" file found in the save location for the game.
[*] Fixed some bugs with the calculations of Stats for how many holds and ropes were spent.
[*] Fixed a bug with the stats on Porter's Boulder.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Great Alps would give a 0 ropes achievement regardless of ropes used.
[*] Fixed a bug with starting new save files.
[/list]
[h2]Patch 1.9.3d[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few bugs and UI inconsistencies in the Score Tiers for required holds and ropes.
[*] Minor brightness fixes on a few materials.
[/list]
[h2]Patch 1.9.3e[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with rope calculation for Stats on Expert peaks.
[*] Initial (first time) loading of Stats will now try to load Collectibles from The Great Gales collectible Items, Tool Unlocks, Ropes collected, and The Great Alps collectible Idols.
[*] The goat on the Alpinist's Cabin will no longer make any noise on entering the cabin when Dunderhorn is cleared.
[*] A button to reset creature sights such as mermaids, eagles and ghostly goats have been added in Main Menu > Options > Misc Options > Reset Creatures. This will only show up if you've seen any with the monocular. Resetting creatures should not reset any associated pins already achieved in the Great Alps.
[*] Eagles will no longer make any noise once all have been seen. This can be reset in Main Menu > Options > Misc Options > Reset Creatures.
[*] Fixed some issues with controller navigation in the Main Menu.
[/list]
[h2]Patch 1.9.3f Hotfix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Overall Time Attack Default Ropes score.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.9.0 - New In-Game DLC Achievements, Collectibles, and Pin Rewards
notes.content:
Hello peakbaggers!

This patch brings a few more in-game rewards, collectibles, and a few other things to the DLC, as well as some end-game challenges. There's also been a few adjustments on a couple of maps in the DLC, so  be sure to check out the update below and in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661083/128a5bbef42da977aa2ea06e6585a0fc88f7683a.png[/img]

[h2]Summit Stamp Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now acquire stamps for completing Alpine summits. Each successful summit will award a stamp for completion. A total of [b]23 stamps can be collected[/b], corresponding to the number of DLC maps.
[*] These work like regular achievements as well as in-game viewable stamps in your Alpinist's Cabin. They will pop into view once you acquire them.
[*] If you have already completed a map, you will automatically have the respective stamp.
[/list]
[h2]Sleeve Pins[/h2]
[list]
[*] New cosmetic sleeve pins have been added. They can be collected by completing [b]new challenges[/b] found in the Great Alps. Be sure to check your Map for new collectibles.
[*] There are a total of [b]11 new cosmetic sleeve pins to unlock[/b]. Once you acquire one, you can display it on your sleeve(s).
[*] Accomplished mountaineers, and those of keen sight, will be awarded with pins to adorn your tweeds.
[*] Once a pin has been awarded, you can find them on your Collected Pins board in the Alpinist's Cabin. Here you can [b]adorn them on your sleeves with Left Trigger / Left Click, or view them up with Right Trigger / Right Click[/b]. 
[*] These [b]pins will be unlocked permanently[/b], unless you delete the save file and remove their unlocks using the option found in Main Menu > Options > Misc Options > Delete Great Alps Unlocks.
[/list]
[h2]Flora and Fauna[/h2]
[list]
[*] During your adventure throughout the Great Alps, you can now find elusive collectible [b]Alpine flowers[/b], soaring [b]Great Eagles[/b], and elusive [b]Ghostly Goats[/b] appearing through the night. 
[*] Use your acquired mountaineering expertise to find and grab these elusive flowers, as they tend to grow in treacherous locations.
[*] A keen eye is needed to spot both Great Eagles and Ghostly Goats. These will not appear on your map, so be sure to be on the lookout during your climbs.
[/list]
[h2]Monument of Sundown & Monument of Cruelty[/h2]
[list]
[*] Monument of Sundown & Monument of Cruelty will now unlock permanently [b]after collecting their respective idols[/b]. [u]These monuments are found on specific peaks listed below[/u]. 
Permanently unlocking these means that [b]they will also appear in new save files in You Fall You Die and Free Solo[/b] if you have unlocked their respective idols at least once.
[*] As they are used as part of new challenges, they will appear on the following maps:
[*] [b]Greenhorn's Top, Towering Vísir, Eldris Wall, Mount Mhòrgorm, and Solemn Tempest[/b].
[*] These monuments will automatically be unlocked if you have collected both the Idol of Sundown and Idol of Cruelty.
[*][b]Note[/b]: Monuments on Greenhorn's Top are not used for any challenges and are simply in case of self-imposed challenges in Normal Mode, You Fall You Die, and Free Solo.
[/list]
[h3]Option to Delete new Alpine Unlocks: "Delete Great Alps Unlocks"[/h3]
[list]
[*] Found in Main Menu > Options > Misc Options > Delete Great Alps Unlocks.
[*] Use to remove any Pin unlocks. 
[*] Use to delete the state of unlocks of Monuments of Sundown and Monuments of Cruelty.
[*] Use to delete the "seen" state of animals in the Great Alps.
[*] Note that some pins will unlock automatically at certain points during a save file if you have enough  progress in it.
[/list]
[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option to disable sunshafts / sun glare with a launch option. Running the game at lower resolutions would blow up the sunglare effect. To add this launch option, right-click the game in your Steam Library, go to Properties, add "[b]-nosg[/b]" without the quotation marks.
[*] Restart map hotkey is now defaulted to 'Home'.
[*] Increased volume stamina regain very slightly after leaving the hold.
[*] Increased the effect of chalk very slightly while on volumes.
[*] Drain speed on volumes very slightly nerfed.
[*] Cracks balance gain nerfed very slightly.
[*] The goat on the roof of the Alpinist's Cabin will now stay until Dunderhorn has been completed.
[*] Added a few extra ice spots and holds on Mount Mhorgorm to better accommodate cruelty difficulty.
[/list]
[h3]Old Rekkja[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 3 Crux names and a couple extra route tweaks / updates to make the map more balanced.
[/list]
[h3]Tutor's Tower[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added additional holds and alternate paths to make the map more balanced and less punishing since it's the first DLC map encountered.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could infinitely crampon jump with Idol of Feathers active. This would trivialize a bunch of achievements.
[*] Fixed a few slopes that you could stand on in Ullr's Chasm.
[*] Fixed a bug with Alpine summits not counting towards peaks summited when in the permadeath cutscene.
[*] Fixed some mesh issues and removed some invisible holds on Almáttr Dam.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Patch 1.9.0a - Hotfix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some visual issues with pins.
[*] Fixed a typo on the information pamphlet in the Alpinist's Cabin.
[/list]

[h3]Patch 1.9.0b - Hotfix[/h3]

Hey peakbaggers! Just a few updates this time around. Be sure to check out the notes below as there are some updates to display resolutions, fullscreen modes, framerate unlocking, and other stuff.

[h2]1.6.6[/h2]

[list]

[*] Fullscreen Mode is now a drop-down to choose between Fullscreen, Fullscreen Borderless, and Windowed.
[/list]
[h3]Display Resolutions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Display resolution options will now show refresh rates (Hz). Be sure to select the one that fits your current screen.
[/list]
[h3]FPS Limit[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an [u]option to unlock the framerate[/u].
[*] By default, the game will try to run at 60 fps (Option: Locked).
[*] If you wish to run the game above 60 fps (Option: Unlocked), [b]I recommend leaving Vertical Sync on in order to prevent screen-tearing and unpredictable gameplay[/b]. 

Even when the FPS is unlocked/uncapped, the framerate will only go as high as your monitor's refresh rate if you have Vertical Sync on.
[/list]
[h3]Vertical Sync[/h3]

If you have Vertical Sync enabled, the game will try to match the framerate to your screen's refresh rate in order to prevent screen-tearing. E.g. when Vertical Sync is on and you run the game on a 144 Hz monitor, the game will try to match the framerate to 144 in order to prevent screen-tearing. 

[h3]Performance[/h3]

If you had performance issues previously, they might be tied to the resolution chosen before this patch. Please make sure you take a look at the resolution options and match them to your preferred display in this patch. 
Specifically, if you play with Vertical Sync enabled, make sure your native monitor refresh rate (Hz) is the same (or close to) the chosen resolution option and Hz.

- Other minor bugfixes.

Added a few basic default 16:9 resolutions as well another check to detect native resolutions that aren't 16:9 specifically.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.0c - Save Slots & Other Updates
notes.content:
Hey peakbaggers. 
This patch overhauls the save system as well as adding a few other updates and bugfixes, so be sure to check out the changes below.

[h2]Overhauled Save System[/h2]
The save system has been replaced with a more stable one that includes save slots, backups, and safety measures that ensures it won't overwrite progress on the off chance that your files corrupt or otherwise. The previous system was outdated and very prone to issues, so hopefully this new system should be more stable all around.

[h2]Save Slots and Backups[/h2][list]

[*] Save and load from [u]3 different save slots[/u] across all modes.
[*] Save slots will display a [b]% COMPLETE[/b] based on your progress in that slot. E.g. [u]90% COMPLETE means you have completed 90% of the game[/u].
[*] With this new system in place, you can now [b]migrate your old save files to the new system once you go to slot selection[/b]. This will migrate your previous save file to the first slot. If you don't have any progress in old files, the migration feature won't show up.
[*] Note, you cannot copy and rename files that come from different modes to other modes in order to cheese progress. Doing this will result in the slot displaying "WRONG FILE MODE" and the save will start from the beginning if pressed.
[*] Backups are now created for save files. In the event of a save file corrupting, your regular save file will display [b]"Corrupt! Use Backup"[/b] and will take you to the Save Folder locally. You can now use the backup files ([b].bac[/b] extension) to retrieve lost progress. Simply remove the .bac extension and [b]rename the slot extension ("PeaksData_Normal_0/1/2") to whatever slot between 0 and 2[/b]. 
[*] Main backup has no additional number after the .bac extension, while files with a number after the .bac extension are backups from different points in the game.
[/list]
[h3]Updates[/h3][list]

[*] Hotkey buttons will no longer readjust view when used on some tools.
[*] Improved the collision detection a bit on slopers and general hand holds.
[*] Improved front-facing crampon jump detection.
[*] Removed Delete Progress from the Main Menu options since the new system incorporates save file deletion. Previous Delete Progress option has been replaced with just deleting Time Attack scores.
[*] [b]Added a secret new "mode" along with an achievement for completing all peaks with it enabled[/b]. 
Can be accessed from the Main Menu after completing the game. Must be used on a fresh file where no peaks have been previously summited. 
[i]I don't expect anyone to complete this, at all...[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with Category 3 not unlocking after appropriate progress in YFYD and Free Solo. Should unlock after either 5 boulders or 20 fundamentals and 1 boulder.
[*] Fixed some issues with velocity during pause.
[*] Fixed a bug with pausing the timer while doing a time trial run and summiting.
[*] Fixed a bug where you coulden't grab coffee from the belt when you were "coffee high".
[*] Fixed a few map collision issues.
[*] Other minor bugfixes and tweaks.
[/list]

[h3]Hotfix 1.6.0a[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with game percentage displaying incorrect numbers.
[*] Migrating will disable as soon as you migrate your progress to the new system. If you delete the first slot file from the new system (delete next to the slot), you will be allowed to migrate the file again.
[/list]
[h3]Hotfix 1.6.0b[/h3]
[list]

[/list]
[h3]Hotfix 1.6.0c[/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.4a - Final Movement Updates
notes.content:
Hey peakbaggers. 
This will be the final patch addressing any [u]major game-breaking[/u] parts to the current arsenal of movement tech. 

This patch fixes a few game-breaking force techniques as well buffing a few things. This should hopefully make the game more approachable from a speed-running perspective, open up more experimentation with routing, as well as eliminate any tech that would require macros or introduce unwanted wrist pain from performing them. 

[b]If you are a casual player, you will not notice these changes other than the buffs to Crampons jumping.[/b]

[h3]Climbing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the reach force very slightly on the first reach.
[/list]
[h3]Ice Axes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the ability to abuse swapping between hands and ice axes to gain extreme vertical force.
[*] Force is only gained from ice axes when leaving the ground
[*] Strike force will be significantly lowered when swapping too frequently between hands and ice axes. This will reset when your momentum goes downward, or when you grab on / latch on with ice axes.
[*] Slightly increased the strike force.
[/list]
[h3]Crampons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crampon jumps are [b]back to 3[/b]. 
Since pickswapping and quick-grab techniques are now out of the game, it opens up the possibility of other routes and using crampons for more experimentation. Previously this was too overpowered when combined with the pick-swapping and quick-grab techniques.
[*] The force given by crampon jumps should feel more consistent across the board.
[*] The first two crampon jumps are the strongest, the third is slightly diminished, and consecutive jumps are much more diminished - signified by failed crampons sound. The jumps will give a little more force if you are falling, allowing you to save yourself from a nasty fall.
[/list]
[h3]Quick-grab Crampon Limitation[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you are holding onto a rock for too short a duration and are going too fast, the [b]crampon jump will fail immediately[/b]. This prevents abuse from quick-grab tech that existed in previous patch. You'll need to hold a rock for at least [u]0.2 seconds[/u] in order to be able to perform fully functioning crampon jumps. 
[*] The failed crampon limitation from quick-grabs will reset as soon as you grab a hold for longer than 0.2 seconds, or if your momentum slow or moving downwards.
[*] This limitation does not apply when using ice axes.
[/list]
These updates should bring back balancing to the overall game, as well as open up more experimentation with routing without having to destroy your wrist learning techniques that would otherwise destroy any other movement techniques on any given map.

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now skip dialogue with stationary NPCs on peaks using "Interact".
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get more than intended crampon jumps from the ground.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could set a score on Sundered Sons and Cromlech before the summit.
[*] Fixed a bug with item collection.
[*] Fixed a few bugs with chalk.
[*] Fixed a visual bug with crampons in Free Solo mode.
[*] Slightly modified Sundered Sons.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could launch yourself using ropes and slopers.
[*] Other minor bugfixes.
[/list]

With these changes more set in stone, hopefully I can spend more time focusing directly on DLC and other content for the foreseeable future.

[h3]Patch 1.5.4a[/h3]
[list]
[*] When using time attack on Solemn Tempest, time, ropes used and holds made will be recorded when quitting using the bivouac, allowing you to continue the time trial run when you next load into the bivouac. Note that ropes placed previously before quitting in the bivouac will not be saved for the next run.
[*] Fixed a bug with gold items.
[/list]

The Routing Flag is a tool to [u]practise sections on a peak[/u]. You'll find the flag at the starting area on peaks you have already completed (and if you have any potential collectable items from the pertaining peak). 
Once picked up, press the hotkey 'G' to to place the Routing Flag on a wall. You can then teleport automatically to wherever you placed it, allowing you to test different leaps and routes to perfect your climbing. The locations of the routing flags will be saved for each individual peak once set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661083/57053f0ff38ddc573a874c3f3d69a26752900e53.png[/img]

[h3]New Mode : Free Solo[/h3]
Test your sanity as your try to conquer all peaks without using ropes, chalk, coffee or smoking pipe in Free Solo. 
Below is a list of what this mode entails.
[list]
[*] Available after unlocking the true ending (Summit all peaks in normal mode).
[*] Ropes, chalk, coffee and pipe are disabled. 
[*] Crampons and Ice Axes are unlocked as you progress like normally.
[*] If you fall, you die. (Permadeath)
[*] An icon next the YFYD icon is added to indicate being in Free Solo Mode.
[*] Unlock new elusive achievements for summitting Fundamentals, Advanced, and Expert categories, as well as summiting all peaks in this mode.
[/list]This mode is affected by permadeath, which means there are noteworthy changes and updates listed below.
[h3]
Changes and Updates to You Fall You Die[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: 1.2.2 Rope Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changes to Rope Anchoring[/h3]

So I've had to do a [b]revert on being able to detach ropes while still being attached[/b]. 

The main reason for this being that it completely trivialized rope collectables, as you could simply go back and pick up other ropes with no issue - essentially being attached all the way through a route, repeatedly gathering the previous anchor. 

This was not intended. This update changes the system back to needing to detach if you want to pick up another anchor. 
I might change this if I find a better solution that doesn't trivialize the challenging aspects of the game, but this will have to be in place for now.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

- Changed Rope Anchoring. [b]Your currently attached rope will be detached once you pull out or place a new anchor.[/b]
- Fixed a bug with slopers (slidy rocks).
- Changed Restart Map to reset the entire current level instead of just the player.
- Tweaked the collision on some secret discoverables.
- Fixed an issue with time attack.
